title: GNURadio: UHD Image
comment: Setiap USRP harus load spesial firmware dan FPGA image. Metoda untuk me-load image ke USRP berbeda tergantung device: USRP1: The host code will automatically load the firmware and FPGA at runtime. USRP2: The user must manually write the images onto the USRP2 SD card. USRP-N Series: The user must manually transfer the images over ethernet.
